system.description:
Where most Kindred still feel the fatigue and pain of their wounds, you shrug such hardships aside — even the searing bite of fire and sunlight can barely slow you.

You suffer no wound penalties from any health level past Bruised, right up until you are struck into torpor or Final Death. Where most vampires lose all ties once Wounded, or lie helpless when Incapacitated, you simply endure the usual penalties of being Bruised. The power is passive and always in effect.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
